projectDescription: A local-model coding agent CLI optimized for small open-source LLMs (8B–30B), using a deterministic expert pipeline with BM25+AST code location, runtime debugging, DAG multi-task execution, and an auto-improving flywheel — all running fully offline.
keyFeatures: Deterministic 5-expert pipeline (Gate → Locator → Generator → Verifier → Debugger → Reviewer)
BM25 + AST call-graph two-stage code location (99.4% accuracy on hidden-dependency tasks)
Debug Subagent using sys.settrace for non-invasive runtime variable capture
DAG multi-task orchestration with parallel and serial dependency support
Auto-improving flywheel: trajectory collection → pattern detection → AB testing → SKILL.md optimization
Three-layer memory system: PROJECT.md, EXPERT.md, PATTERN.md + REFLECTION.md
Context compression for small-model (8K–32K) windows via algorithmic pruning
Fully offline operation — code never leaves the local machine
15 built-in domain experts (FastAPI, BugFix, TestGen, SpringBoot, etc.)
Cross-Encoder search reranking and SearXNG self-hosted search integration
Windows-native support (cmd/PowerShell) with full Chinese localization
